<documents>
<document id="account-verification-time">
HowˆlongˆverificationˆtakesˆMostˆapplicationsˆareˆverifiedˆwithinˆ1ˆbusinessˆday,ˆandˆmanyˆwithinˆminutes.ˆ##ˆManualˆreviewˆIfˆweˆneedˆtoˆcheckˆsomethingˆbyˆhand,ˆitˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆmayˆaskˆforˆanotherˆdocument,ˆsuchˆasˆproofˆofˆaddress.ˆ##ˆWhileˆyouˆwaitˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆdepositsˆintoˆyourˆnewˆaccount,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcashˆorˆorderˆaˆcardˆuntilˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆCheckingˆstatusˆTheˆappˆshowsˆyourˆverificationˆstatusˆonˆtheˆhomeˆscreen.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆasˆsoonˆasˆit'sˆdone.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆspeedˆitˆup?ˆNo.ˆVerificationˆisˆhandledˆbyˆourˆVerificationˆteam,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆapproveˆapplicationsˆorˆtellˆyouˆmoreˆthanˆtheˆappˆshows.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆanythingˆfromˆyou,ˆwe'llˆaskˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆCommonˆcausesˆofˆdelaysˆAˆblurryˆIDˆphoto,ˆaˆnameˆthatˆdoesn'tˆmatchˆyourˆIDˆexactly,ˆorˆaˆrecentˆmoveˆareˆtheˆmostˆcommonˆreasonsˆweˆneedˆaˆmanualˆreview.ˆCheckingˆtheseˆbeforeˆyouˆapplyˆhelps.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-status">
CheckingˆtheˆstatusˆofˆaˆdisputeˆYouˆcanˆfollowˆeveryˆdisputeˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDisputes,ˆandˆchooseˆtheˆcase.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtheˆstatusesˆmeanˆ-ˆ**Submitted:**ˆwe'veˆreceivedˆitˆandˆareˆdoingˆanˆinitialˆreview.ˆ-ˆ**Provisionalˆcreditˆissued:**ˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆbackˆinˆyourˆaccountˆwhileˆweˆinvestigate.ˆ-ˆ**Waitingˆonˆmerchant:**ˆwe'veˆcontactedˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetworkˆandˆareˆwaitingˆforˆitsˆresponse.ˆ-ˆ**Moreˆinformationˆneeded:**ˆwe'veˆaskedˆyouˆforˆsomething.ˆCheckˆyourˆmessages.ˆ-ˆ**Resolvedˆinˆyourˆfavor:**ˆtheˆcreditˆisˆpermanent.ˆ-ˆ**Denied:**ˆwe'veˆsentˆanˆexplanation,ˆandˆanyˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwillˆbeˆtakenˆback.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆMostˆdisputesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays,ˆandˆsomeˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ90ˆdays.ˆWe'llˆmessageˆyouˆwheneverˆtheˆstatusˆchanges.ˆ##ˆAddingˆinformationˆYouˆcanˆuploadˆdocumentsˆorˆaddˆnotesˆtoˆanˆopenˆdisputeˆfromˆtheˆcaseˆpageˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆCancellingˆaˆdisputeˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆrefundsˆyouˆdirectly,ˆwithdrawˆtheˆdisputeˆfromˆtheˆcaseˆpageˆsoˆyouˆaren'tˆcreditedˆtwice.ˆIfˆyouˆwereˆcreditedˆtwice,ˆwe'llˆtakeˆbackˆtheˆextraˆamount.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="account-eligibility">
WhoˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆopenˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆifˆyou:ˆ-ˆAreˆatˆleastˆ18ˆyearsˆoldˆ-ˆLiveˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆhaveˆaˆUSˆresidentialˆaddressˆ(notˆaˆPOˆbox)ˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITINˆ-ˆHaveˆanˆunexpiredˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆsmartphoneˆthatˆcanˆrunˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆ##ˆOpeningˆanˆaccountˆDownloadˆtheˆappˆandˆtapˆGetˆstarted.ˆYou'llˆenterˆyourˆdetails,ˆtakeˆaˆphotoˆofˆyourˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie.ˆEveryˆaccountˆstartsˆonˆBasic,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆonceˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆOneˆaccountˆperˆpersonˆEachˆpersonˆcanˆhaveˆoneˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆbusinessˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆpeopleˆunderˆ18.ˆ##ˆLivingˆabroadˆIfˆyouˆmoveˆabroadˆpermanently,ˆyouˆmayˆneedˆtoˆcloseˆyourˆaccount.ˆTellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆmove.ˆ##ˆPreviouslyˆclosedˆbyˆusˆIfˆTallowbrookˆclosedˆanˆaccountˆofˆyoursˆinˆtheˆpast,ˆaˆnewˆapplicationˆmayˆbeˆdeclined.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Do you have business checking?
